page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top. Main text in one column of prose with a heading and a Sequentia. Below the prose, two parallel columns of verse (left and right). No margin notes. Page number at top left.

main_text.p: Completa Deus, qui beatos Joachim & Annam diu steriles, tandem prole voluisti gloriosa & humano generi salutifera, etiam sine peccati macula foecundari; da quaesumus, ut omnes, qui parentes illos, amore piae Filiae, Deiparae matris, venerantur, ipsorum meritis & precibus aeternae gaudia vitae capiamus, per Dominum &c.
main_text.head: DE S. JOACHIMO, SEORSIM.
main_text.p: Graduale. O Maria, Dei genitrix, benedictus sit pater tuus sanctus Joachim, a quo sine peccati macula processit caro tua virginea. Halleluja.
main_text.head: SEQUENTIA.

page.notes: Verse is set in two parallel columns; the left column is read first, then the right. The number "212" is read from the top left. Catchword "Te" at bottom right is a faint printed word, uncertain. Several lines in the verse columns are italic and partly damaged; readings marked by context are not certain.
